resources.string: Inspect selected foreground sensor readings and availability.
Vector axes use the device sensor coordinate system, not automatically the current screen rotation. Proximity values are often binary, not precise distance.
Rotation vector X/Y/Z and optional W are dimensionless quaternion components, not angles in degrees. Three-component sensors may omit W.
Availability and reported accuracy do not certify hardware health or calibration. Missing, waiting or invalid readings are not zero. This fixed inventory excludes permission-sensitive sensors.

Start is explicit. Selecting another sensor or leaving/backgrounding stops sensing and clears readings. No samples, device fingerprint, History or Workbench entries are saved or shared; no network or extra permission is used.
Choose one supported sensor and tap Start. Stop or change selection to clear readings; return from background requires Start again.
Choose Accelerometer and gently tilt the device to observe X/Y/Z components.
Hardware-dependent readings are not diagnostic certification. Rotation vectors are dimensionless; proximity may be binary. No persistent samples or fingerprint sharing.
